items.source: toolChoice - Controls which (if any) function is called by the model. none means the model will not call a function and instead generates a message. auto means the model can pick between generating a message or calling a function. Specifying a particular function via {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} forces the model to call that function. none is the default when no functions are present. auto is the default if functions are present. Use the DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionRequest.ToolChoiceBuilder to create the tool choice value.
items.translation: toolChoice - 控制模型调用哪个（如果有）函数。none 表示模型不会调用函数，而是生成消息。auto 表示模型可以在生成消息或调用函数之间进行选择。通过指定特定函数 {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} 强制模型调用该函数。当没有函数存在时，默认值为 none；当存在函数时，默认值为 auto。使用 DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionRequest.ToolChoiceBuilder 创建 tool choice 值。

items.source: messages - A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.
items.translation: messages - 迄今为止对话所包含的消息列表。

items.source: model - ID of the model to use.
items.translation: model - 要使用的模型 ID。

items.source: frequencyPenalty - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
items.translation: frequencyPenalty - 介于 -2.0 和 2.0 之间的数字。正值会根据文本中现有 token 的频率对新 token 进行惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复相同内容的概率。

items.source: maxTokens - The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion. This value can be used to control costs for text generated via API. This value is now deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens, and is not compatible with o1 series models.
items.translation: maxTokens - 聊天补全中可生成的最大 token 数量。此值可用于控制通过 API 生成文本的成本。该参数现已弃用，转而使用 max_completion_tokens，且与 o1 系列模型不兼容。

items.source: presencePenalty - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
items.translation: presencePenalty - 介于 -2.0 和 2.0 之间的数字。正值会根据新 token 是否已出现在当前文本中进行惩罚，从而提高模型讨论新话题的可能性。

items.source: responseFormat - An object specifying the format that the model must output. Setting to { "type": "json_object" } enables JSON mode, which guarantees the message the model generates is valid JSON.
items.translation: responseFormat - 一个指定模型必须输出的格式的对象。 设置为 { "type": "json_object" } 可启用 JSON 模式，确保模型生成的消息是有效的 JSON。

items.source: stop - A string or a list containing up to 4 strings, upon encountering these words, the API will cease generating more tokens.
items.translation: stop - 一个字符串或包含最多四个字符串的列表，当遇到这些单词时，API 将停止生成更多 token。

items.source: stream - If set, partial message deltas will be sent.Tokens will be sent as data-only server-sent events as they become available, with the stream terminated by a data: [DONE] message.
items.translation: stream - 如果设置，将发送部分消息增量。随着令牌可用，它们将以仅数据服务器发送事件的形式发送，流以 data: [DONE] 消息终止。

items.source: temperature - What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. We generally recommend altering this or top_p but not both.
items.translation: temperature - 使用的采样温度，范围在 0 到 2 之间。较高的值（如 0.8）会使输出更加随机，而较低的值（如 0.2）则使输出更加聚焦和确定性。我们通常建议调整此参数或 top_p，但不要同时调整两者。

items.source: topP - An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.
items.translation: topP - 一种替代温度采样的方法，称为核采样（nucleus sampling），模型在此模式下仅考虑概率质量前 top_p 的 token 结果。例如，0.1 表示只考虑累积概率质量前 10% 的 token。我们通常建议调整此参数或温度参数，但不同时调整两者。

items.source: logprobs - Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
items.translation: logprobs - 是否返回输出 token 的对数概率。如果为 true，则返回 message 内容中每个输出 token 的对数概率。

items.source: topLogprobs - An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability. logprobs must be set to true if this parameter is used.
items.translation: topLogprobs - 一个介于 0 到 20 之间的整数，指定在每个 token 位置返回的最可能 token 数量，每个 token 都带有相关的对数概率。如果使用了此参数，必须将 logprobs 设置为 true。

items.source: tools - A list of tools the model may call. Currently, only functions are supported as a tool. Use this to provide a list of functions the model may generate JSON inputs for.
items.translation: tools - 模型可能调用的工具列表。目前仅支持函数作为工具。使用此参数提供模型可生成 JSON 输入的函数列表。
